stripe.what: Switch Stripe from test to live mode
stripe.why: Payments won't process real money in test mode

email.what: Get SMTP credentials for email delivery
email.how: Sign up at resend.com (free tier: 100 emails/day). Set in Railway: SMTP_HOST=smtp.resend.com, SMTP_PORT=587, SMTP_USER=resend, SMTP_PASS=re_...
email.why: Welcome emails, approval/rejection/payout notifications won't send without this

google_oauth.what: Publish the Google OAuth consent screen
google_oauth.how: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → 'Publish App'
google_oauth.why: Currently only test users can sign in with Google. Publishing makes it available to everyone.

google_analytics.why: Won't track any page views or conversions without this

spotify.what: Add Spotify API credentials for monthly listener counts on artist cards
spotify.how: Create app at developer.spotify.com → get Client ID + Secret. Railway: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=..., SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET=...
spotify.why: Artist cards will show 'X monthly listeners' social proof

youtube.what: Add YouTube Data API key for view verification
youtube.how: Google Cloud Console → APIs → YouTube Data API v3 → Create API key. Railway: YOUTUBE_API_KEY=...
youtube.why: Creators' YouTube views won't auto-verify without this

critical_for_mvp: STRIPE (sk_live_) — no real payments without this
GOOGLE OAUTH PUBLISH — no one can sign up via Google without this
YOUTUBE_API_KEY — submissions won't auto-verify views without this
